FOLLOW: The LLM receives corrupted code extracts (e.g., Python indentation destroyed, variable names like "sufficient" changed to "enough"), making the review target unreadable and leading to false positive bug reports.
ANALYSE: HARD constraint (correctness). Task data must be preserved verbatim. CONFIRMED.
FIX:

        situation.text = _apply_phenotype_transform(situation.text, transform)
        packets.append(situation)
====

        if "interaction_pattern" in situation.tags:
            situation.text = _apply_phenotype_transform(situation.text, transform)
        packets.append(situation)
>>>> REPLACE
FALSIFICATION:
FALSIFIER:

from bench.cdsfl_registry.composer import compose
res = compose("software", "deepseek_v3", review_target="def foo():\n    sufficient = True")

print("FALSIFIED: code was mangled by phenotype transform")

        return "verbosity", "high"

        if any(w in lower for w in ("do not", "avoid", "without", "never")):

FINDING_ID: F002
SEVERITY: 0.95
FLAW_CLASS: 1
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.8
FIND: `_build_situation_packet` assigns `constraint_class="SOFT"` to the `confer_packet`, which contains the `review_target` and `code_extracts`.
FOLLOW: Because it is SOFT and in the `situation` layer (which is first in `prune_order`), the task data is the very first thing to be intra-pruned or dropped when the coherence budget is exceeded. Intra-pruning silently deletes sections from the bottom up (Adversarial Brief -> Explicit Unknowns -> Verified Facts -> Code Extracts). The LLM is left reviewing nothing, rendering the dispatch useless.
ANALYSE: HARD constraint (correctness). The input data for the task is non-negotiable and must never be pruned to meet a constraint density budget. It must be classified as HARD. CONFIRMED.
FIX:
<<<< SEARCH bench/cdsfl_registry/composer.py
    return DirectivePacket(
        layer="situation",
        name="confer_packet",
        text="\n\n".join(sections),
        constraint_class="SOFT",
        tags={"situation", "task_specific"},
    )
====
    return DirectivePacket(
        layer="situation",
        name="confer_packet",
        text="\n\n".join(sections),
        constraint_class="HARD",
        tags={"situation", "task_specific"},

>>>> REPLACE

FALSIFIER:
